verdict.rationale: Docusign's first-party docs say senders can require recipients to upload a government ID and pass a biometric challenge, verify by one-time passcode sent to their phone, and adjust verification type through a Risk-Based Verification workflow. The eSignature plan advertises '5 identity verifications.' Together these cover requiring stronger verification on sensitive agreements. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of knowledge-based authentication (KBA), no detail on per-document or per-envelope configuration, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
